answer.evidence: Line loss A-TX to B-ODF = 12.12dB matches commissioning, so fibre OK. Extra ~10.1dB B-ODF to B-RX indicates 10dB attenuator fitted instead of design 0dB during 19th RMA refit, driving Rx to -21.3dBm below -15dBm sensitivity with high BER. Tx normal, B-ODF clean, OTDR shows no fibre fault.

evidence_refs.quote: Receiver module at site B replaced under RMA. Attenuator refitted from spares box.
